title: Roasted Cauliflower
description: Cauliflower florets roasted until golden and lightly charred, seasoned simply with salt or a spice mix of choice.
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, leaves and stalk removed, cut into bite-sized florets
salt or spice mix of your choice
steps: Cover a baking tray with parchment; spread cauliflower in an even layer; spray with cooking spray.
Season with salt or add 1 tbsp spice mix.
Roast 15 minutes; flip with a spatula; roast another 10 minutes until golden with some blackened edges.
notes: Peri-peri spice mix is Pip's favourite pairing. Cauliflower rice: pulse raw cauliflower in food processor, spread on tray, spray and roast at 220°C for 10 minutes.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
